headline: Sanshang Life's last trading day is 8/19! Officially delisted 9/1; 245 "thousand-lot major holders" still in the market | ETtoday Finance Cloud
summary: E.SUN Financial Holding has received FSC approval to acquire 100% of Sanshang Meiban Life Insurance. Sanshang's last trading day is August 19, with delisting on September 1.
why: E.SUN Financial is a Taiwanese financial holding company, and Sanshang Life is a Taiwanese life insurer that is being absorbed in the deal.
